```yaml
name: Pre-commit CI Autofix Trigger

on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches:
      - master
    types:
      - labeled
      - synchronize

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  checks: read
  statuses: read
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  trigger-autofix:
    if: |
      github.event.pull_request.user.type == 'Bot' ||
      endsWith(github.actor, '[bot]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run pre-commit ci autofix trigger
        uses: shaypal5/pre-commit-ci-autofix-trigger@55d00aab
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
